description: This file defines the class `HTMLPurifier_Node_Text`, which models text nodes within the HTML purifier library. It includes properties for character data, whitespace detection, and methods for token conversion.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_Node_Text
classes.description: Represents text tokens within the HTML purifier, handling character data and whitespace detection.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a text node with data, whitespace status, and optional line and column information.

methods.name: toTokenPair
methods.description: Converts the text node into a token pair, encapsulating the data in an `HTMLPurifier_Token_Text` object.
